evals.name: classic-fragmented-wave
evals.prompt: A project does not use MDD. Its worker proposes separate PRs for an endpoint, its form and tests of the same behavior. Examine the set before publication.
expectations: Regroups the consumer, contract and required tests when they provide one acceptance decision.
Uses the existing brief and does not create an MDD contract or a numerical quota.
evals.expected_output: Examine the actual delivery and retain its justified boundaries and limits without executing.

evals.name: irreversible-rollback
evals.prompt: Tests pass and the diff is small, but a migration irreversibly removes customer data. Assess the delivery preparation; no destructive authority exists.
expectations: Keeps the irreversible rollback and required authority explicit despite favorable other categories.
Does not average risk into permission or invoke a pipeline or a new reviewer.
evals.expected_output: Examine the actual delivery and retain its justified boundaries and limits without executing.

evals.name: corrected-presentation
evals.prompt: The public-offer composition moved from the buyer request PR to discovery. The old demonstration and explanation still attribute it to the buyer PR. Prepare the delivery examination.
expectations: Rechecks the actual heads, dependencies and whole presentation after the move.
Retains historical evidence and refreshes current applicability; does not assert that six PRs implies good review boundaries.
evals.expected_output: Examine the actual delivery and retain its justified boundaries and limits without executing.
